title: Valuing Remaining Hours for a TimeBank Extension Fee
content:
**Extension valuation schedule (TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours).** The value of each remaining hour in an extension fee is set as follows:

1. a block carrying hours rolled in from an earlier block values each hour at its invoiced block price divided by its hours purchased plus the hours rolled in, rounded half up to the cent;
2. a block without rolled-in hours whose invoiced price is below the list price of its size values each hour at its invoiced price divided by its hours purchased, rounded half up to the cent;
3. any other block values each hour at the rate per block hour of its size.

The invoiced block price is the amount of the block's own block invoice; the hours rolled in are those the block's hours ledger shows arriving by rollover.

| Block (hypothetical) | Value of an hour |
|---|---|
| 40-Hour Block invoiced at 5600.00 with 10.00 hours rolled in | 5600.00 divided by 50.00, that is 112.00 |
| 40-Hour Block invoiced at 5600.00, list price 6000.00, nothing rolled in | 5600.00 divided by 40, that is 140.00 |
| 40-Hour Block invoiced at its list price 6000.00, nothing rolled in | 150.00, the size's rate |
